remarks: Second floor Fractional ownership. Two bedroom/two bathroom suite allows you to use the unit, rent the unit or a combination of both. Tamarack Fractional ownership includes 10-11 weeks per year, or about 1 week per month, and the weeks rotate yearly. Ownership amenities include year 'round access to the heated indoor/outdoor pool, hot tubs, sauna, fitness center, private locker room and private lounge. Valet parking is available at no additional fee, and underground parking is available when lodging overnight. Discounts available for you and your family on skiing as well as golf. Ellicottville living at a fraction of the cost!
